_comment: GVK Private AI - Example shared roster template. Copy to personas/roster.json (git-ignored) and replace all bogus placeholder values with your private group roster.
_comment_users_dict: Profiles shown on the user selection screen in core/menu.py. Keys are numeric slot IDs ('1'..'17'). Set 'locked': true for restricted slots (e.g., the persona's own slot) and 'experimental': true for optional/secondary contacts.
_comment_persona_select_items: Personas listed in the main persona picker. 'persona_id' must match personas/<persona_id>/ and adapters/<persona_id>.gguf. Set 'available': false for unbuilt future slots.
_comment_ua_to_ru_names: Optional map converting UI display names (e.g., Ukrainian spelling) into the exact name form used in the model's training prompts/chats.
_comment_interlocutor_descriptions: Short relationship context injected into the system prompt when that user is selected in the UI. Keep descriptions factual and consistent with your training dataset.

interlocutor_descriptions.Sam Rivera: Sam Rivera (close college friend, co-op gaming partner, lives in Berlin)
interlocutor_descriptions.Jordan Blake: Jordan Blake (high school friend, amateur photographer, always late to meetups)
interlocutor_descriptions.Casey Lin: Casey Lin (mutual friend from the weekend hiking group)

_comment_splash_message: Optional custom splash text shown on startup in core/menu.py.
splash_message:
GVK PRIVATE AI // PRIVATE ARCHIVE SESSION
Press any key to continue...
_comment_warning_screens: Optional list of [title, body] disclaimer screens shown before entering the user selector.
warning_screens: This is a local AI simulation trained on archived conversations, not the real person.
All private persona weights and memories remain strictly in RAM for the duration of this session.
